subject: Order form: invoice cutover, net terms & tax residency details needed
body:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order form: invoice cutover, net terms & tax residency details needed

Hi team — following up on the Order Form draft we shared. Two quick asks so we can finalize:

1) PO & invoice routing: please confirm the PO number (so we can map invoices) and the legal entity you want us to invoice (Acme Corp US vs Acme UK) — this impacts VAT/withholding.
2) Tax residency evidence: if you expect reverse-charge VAT or local withholding, send the relevant VAT ID / tax certificate.

Attached is the latest OrderForm (Acme_OrderForm_v3.pdf) with the pricing schedule and staged commit lines. Highlights:
- Minimum commit: $250k first-year (phased quarterly)
- Billing cadence: Redwood proposes monthly invoices mapped to usage, but we're flexible to quarter invoicing if that maps to your finance cycles.
- Net terms: standard Net45; open to Net60 if required by PO.

If you can provide PO number + VAT/tax documents by end of week, we can push the order form to DocuSign and schedule the dedicated capacity start.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Acme_OrderForm_v3.pdf (PDF, 84KB)]

----
From: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Tax <tax@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 14:30:22 -0400
Subject: Re: Order form: invoice cutover, net terms & tax residency details needed

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks — we can confirm PO# ACME-PO-12345 (attached). A couple of clarifications from our side:

- Entity to invoice: we prefer invoices to go to Acme Technologies, Inc. (US entity) for this scope. Is Redwood able to invoice the US entity directly?
- VAT / Withholding: our finance team flagged that the UK subsidiary may be the consuming entity for some services; we provided VAT ID below but need to know whether Redwood will charge VAT or if reverse-charge applies.
- Invoicing frequency: our payments team prefers quarterly invoices that align to commit tranches. Can you map the staged commit lines in the Order Form to a quarterly invoice schedule rather than monthly usage?

Attached: Acme_PO_12345.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

Procurement
Acme Corporation
procurement@acme.com

----
From: Acme Tax <tax@acme.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Acme Legal <legal@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 10:05:10 +0100
Subject: Re: Order form: invoice cutover, net terms & tax residency details needed

Kimberly — one more from tax:

- VAT ID: GB999888777 (attached in case you need it).
- We need to confirm whether Redwood is registered for VAT in the UK or whether we should self-account under reverse charge. If Redwood invoices the US entity, would tax still be chargeable to Acme UK?
- Evidence requested: please confirm the minimum set of tax docs you require (VAT ID + company registration + certificate of residence), and whether a signed Order Form is sufficient for your invoicing teams.

Thanks,
Marta Rivera
Senior Tax Manager, Acme Corporation
[tax@acme.com]

----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Acme Tax <tax@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 15:40:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form: invoice cutover, net terms & tax residency details needed

Looping in our commercial lead and legal ops. Quick proposal from Redwood:

- Invoice entity: Redwood can invoice Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) for the services in the Order Form. If Acme requires UK invoicing for VAT purposes we can supply separate invoices from Redwood EMEA (pending tax registration status).
- Proposed scheduling: map the staged commit lines to quarterly invoices that align to your PO tranches. We'll generate a quarterly invoice schedule and share with your AP team.
- Net terms: Net45 is our default; we can accept Net60 for enterprise POs if finance needs it (note: pricing and credit terms would be locked-in on the order form).
- Tax evidence: request Acme provide VAT ID + certificate of residence (if applicable). We'll confirm whether Redwood needs a W-8/W-9 equivalent for US tax treatment.

Attaching our internal invoice routing playbook for reference: Invoice_Routing_Playbook.pdf (attachment).

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Invoice_Routing_Playbook.pdf (PDF, 160KB)]

----
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Acme Tax <tax@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: final: Proposed invoice flow and net terms confirmation

Thanks for the quick responses — summary and next steps below so we have a single source of truth before DocuSign.

Summary (agreed unless you flag changes):
- PO: ACME-PO-12345 confirmed.
- Invoice entity: Redwood will invoice Acme Technologies, Inc. (US). If Acme needs EMEA invoices for any UK-consumed services, please flag which line items — we'll route those to Redwood EMEA pending registration.
- Billing cadence: Redwood to issue quarterly invoices aligned to the staged commit tranches in the attached Order Form. We will send an invoice schedule within 48 hours.
- Net terms: Net45 accepted. If Acme needs Net60 we can process as an exception with a one-time admin approval (please confirm asap).
- Tax docs: Acme to provide VAT ID (received) and certificate of tax residency / company registration if reverse-charge is expected. Once we have that we will confirm VAT treatment on the invoice.

Action items:
- Acme Procurement: confirm whether any line items must be invoiced by Redwood EMEA (reply here with item numbers). (Due: EOD Mon 21 Jul)
- Acme Tax: send certificate of residence if reverse-charge is expected. (Due: EOD Mon 21 Jul)
- Redwood: Rishi to circulate a quarterly invoice schedule + final Order Form with updated invoice routing. (Due: Wed 23 Jul)

Attachments we will push to DocuSign: Acme_OrderForm_v3.pdf (updated to show quarterly invoice mapping). Link to DocuSign in related links.

If this all looks good, please reply with an OK and any line-item routing notes. Once signed we'll kick off account provisioning.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
[Signature block]

[Attachment: Acme_OrderForm_v3.pdf (PDF, 88KB)]
